user.title: Choose a HealthPlanet mode
user.description: Hybrid is recommended. Official data supplies weight, body fat, blood pressure, and pulse; the experimental website source supplies only body-composition metrics unavailable from the official API.

website_opt_in.title: Experimental website data
website_opt_in.description: Enable the unofficial website source only if you want the eight supplemental body-composition sensors. You must explicitly accept both warnings on the next step.

website.title: Experimental website source
website.description: This internal endpoint is unofficial and may stop working. The password is stored in Home Assistant .storage, which is not a dedicated encrypted password vault. Cookies and CSRF state remain in memory only.

data.experimental_confirmed: I accept the unofficial endpoint risk

reauth_website.title: Reauthenticate website source
reauth_website.description: Only website credentials are replaced. The existing password is never prefilled.

reconfigure.title: Upgrade to Hybrid
reconfigure.description: This starts the standard Home Assistant OAuth flow and preserves the existing website credentials.

data.upgrade_to_hybrid: Upgrade this Website-only entry to Hybrid

init.title: HealthPlanet polling
init.description: Minimum 30 minutes. The website endpoint is unofficial and should not be polled frequently.
